comment.body: The pasted bootstrapper log already shows the failing condition: the per-user installer detected an existing all-users PowerToys installation (0.65.0) and intentionally blocked that combination with error 0x81f40001. A maintainer response should explain that the next step is to uninstall the existing all-users installation first or use the matching all-users installer package instead of the per-user UserSetup executable.
